title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Analog Sound Preservation: MAC >> Nakamichi DRAGON => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit / 5.8 MHz Stereo] >>  Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: FOB Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M > MAC; Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = Maxell UDXLII-S Analog

ai_review.summary: A blazing Rochester show captured on a very clean audience tape – Birdsong, To Lay Me Down and Stella Blue shine.
ai_review.review: The April‑9‑1982 performance is described as “smokin’” from the opening Bama>Greatest Story through a fire‑filled first set to Chinarider, with a second set that delivers a powerful Other One, delicate Stella Blue and heartfelt To Lay Me Down. Reviewers rave about the pristine audience recording mastered by Jim Vita, noting the tape’s clarity and balance.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are enthusiastic (4‑5 stars) and highlight both a high‑energy show with multiple standout songs and an excellent, clean audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clean audience tape; crisp, well‑balanced mix praised by reviewers; Vita’s mastering work noted as superb.

standout_songs: Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as a blaze of fire through to Chinarider; second set maintains high intensity with strong transitions and emotive moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals praised (JG/BW voices noted as excellent for ’81/’82); implied solid guitar work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals praised alongside Jerry’s; strong rhythm and singing noted.
